{{Quote|General Ares Nune reporting in. Am commencing another sweep of the Phu system and surrounding area. No sign of enemy activity.|Ares Nune's last words|<ref name="TCW:S" />}}
'''Ares Nune''' was a [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Nune was given a task force&mdash;consisting of at least three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]&mdash;to patrol the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity. While on patrol, he and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]] began to discuss the mission on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of Nune's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Laudable]]''. However, while they were talking, the task force was [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] equipped with two giant [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. Under the command of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the ''Malevolence'' disabled the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the entire Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] with its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and proceeded to destroy the entire task force. Nune and Kite were [[Death/Legends|killed]], along with everyone else in the fleet.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I just hope whatever it is we're facing is planetside, sir. I'd rather die with dirt, not deckplates, under my boots.''"<br />"''Hopefully, commander, you needn't be faced with that choice at all.|Kite and Nune, shortly before being killed by the ''Malevolence''|<ref name="TCW:S" />}}
[[File:Kite_Nune_talking.png|thumb|left|250px|Kite and Nune talking on the bridge of the ''Laudable'']]
A [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Ares Nune was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who became a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW:S" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Nune was assigned a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] consisting of at least three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], including his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Laudable]]'', to patrol the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity.<ref name="TCW:P">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref>

While on patrol, the task force's initial [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] sweeps reported no enemy activity. However, Nune, from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Laudable'', ordered another scan of the area to be sure nothing had been missed. While the secondary sweeps were underway, Nune and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]], who was also stationed aboard the ''Laudable'', began to discuss their mission.<ref name="TCW:S" />

[[File:Ares_Nune_death.png|thumb|right|100px|The death of Ares Nune]]
However, a new Confederate weapon was hiding out of sight of the Republic task force in the form of the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] under the command of the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. As Nune and Kite were finishing up their conversation, Grievous ordered the ''Malevolence'' to [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|fire]] its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] at the Republic task force, which disabled the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the entire Republic fleet. The ''Malevolence'' destroyed the ''Laudable'', along with the rest of the Republic fleet, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Nune, Kite, and everyone else onboard.<ref name="TCW:S" />

The loss of Nune's battle group was later reported in a press release by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. An audio recording taken during the attack survived the battle, and the transmission was played during the broadcast. Despite the quick destruction of the ''Laudable'', the recording stated that an evacuation of the ''Laudable'' via its [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] had been attempted, but the crew was not quick enough to escape.<ref name="HoloNet News">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You have a refreshingly singular outlook, Kite. The enemy had best be prepared.|Ares Nune|<ref name="TCW:S" />}}
Nune had a sense of humor, joking about Kite's overly singular-minded outlook on life. Nune was also precautious, ordering another sensor sweep of the Phu [[Star system/Legends|system]], even though the first sweep reported no enemy sightings. He had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TCW:S" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Ares Nune was briefly mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Prelude|''Prelude'']], which led into "[[Ambush]],"<ref name="TCW:S" /> the first episode in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Ambush Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}}</ref> Nune made his first appearance in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shakedown|''Shakedown'']], which led into "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']],"<ref name="TCW:S" /> the second episode in ''The Clone Wars'' television series.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

The loss of Nune's task force was reported in the [[in-universe]] ''[[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided]]'', the first installment of the online Holonet News [[Wikipedia:Podcast|podcast]] series that took place before the events of "Rising ''Malevolence''."<ref name="All Hear This">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>
